name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v525: Fixed invisible WebView toggle (was inverted - now "Hide" actually hides the WebView). Fixed app-open cookie freshness check - cookies saved by older versions without a timestamp are treated as fresh so the bypass doesn't launch unnecessarily. Invisible mode now truly hides all UI (title, status, progress) - WebView solves in background. All v524 features retained: cookie age check on open, probe throttle once per minute, skip probe when cookie fresh, stream-link cache ~20 min, one canonical AnimePahe domain.
